title: Deployment limitation and first-step extrapolation
panels: a audit grade distributions; b displacement-grade jump; c endpoint/first-step geometry pairs; d static accuracy is not deployment robustness
scientific_message: Under the frozen source-oracle geometry contract, about 0.002-0.004 Angstrom displacement coincides with immediate MaxVol applicability rejection at grades about 48-148 while endpoints remain near grade one.
mandatory_caveat: These are source-oracle-recovered first attempted integration-update configurations; grade is an applicability criterion, not a measured DFT error or usable MD trajectory.
